annotations.title: Get sports scores, box scores, odds and standings

description: Scores and schedules, player box scores, betting odds (opening vs current or closing moneyline, spread and total, line movement, no-vig probability, and how each line settled), standings and rosters for 24 leagues: NFL, NBA, WNBA, MLB, NHL, college football and basketball, Premier League, LaLiga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Champions League and more, MLS, Liga MX, Formula 1, ATP and WTA tennis (with rankings), PGA golf and UFC. Filter by date, status and team or player. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/sports-data on your Apify account (about $0.003 per game, odds row, standings row or player; $0.001 per box-score player line; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

data_type.description: games, boxScores (one row per player per game), odds (one row per game per sportsbook), standings (tennis: rankings), teams or rosters. Box scores, teams and rosters cover team sports.

days_ahead.description: Days ahead for schedules and upcoming lines.

days_back.description: Days back from today; 1 = yesterday and today.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

game_status.description: final for results and closing lines, scheduled for fixtures.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 5000). Cost scales with this.

season.description: Season year for standings, e.g. 2026; empty = current.

teams.description: Team or player names or abbreviations, e.g. ["Lakers", "KC", "Sinner"].

name: get_sports_data

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.
